newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NBS Boland, others, renew cautionaries.
newsitem.headline: NBS Boland, others, renew cautionaries.

text.p: Bankers involved with talks between South African financial firms Samgro Investment Holdings Ltd, Board of Executors Ltd, Pepgro and NBS Boland said on Tuesday the firms had reached an agreement.
"Agreement in principle has been reached...the relevant regulatory approvals are being sought," BOE Natwest and Real Africa Durolink said in a statement.
"A further announcement is expected to be made on or about August 22," they added,
Samgro and BOE made a standby offer to NBS Boland minority shareholders on June 2, but the NBS Boland price did not fall below the offer price and no deals were closed.

Samgro and Boland Bank shares have been suspended since the merger of NBS and Boland pending restructuring of the group and NBS Boland shares have climbed amid speculation on the future of the new banking group, Boland and BOE.
The banks warned all shareholders in the companies involved to continue to use caution when dealing in their shares.
